versions.changelog: uvx prereqs, airline booking links, metro area mapping

Initial release of flights-search.

- Search real-time flight schedules and prices via Google Flights data from the command line.
- Filter results by stops, departure time, cabin class, and number of passengers.
- Option to display Google Flights booking links for selected flights.
- Defaults to showing flights with the fewest stops; shows all stops with a flag.
- Easy installation with pip and straightforward CLI usage.
